definitions.gloss: to be based on, to be grounded on
definitions.explanation: To have something as a foundation or basis.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{基|もと}づく⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧
⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{基|もと}づいて⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To judge based on the law.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{基|もと}づいて⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's important to make judgments based on experience.

notes:
{基|もと}づく means to be based on or grounded in something. Always takes the particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive verb (the basis takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ particle).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{基|もと}づく: based on ~
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{基|もと}づいて: based on ~ (te-form, adverbial)
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{基|もと}づいた: based on ~ (attributive)
- ⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{基|もと}づく: based on facts
- ⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{基|もと}づいて: based on the law
- ⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{基|もと}づく: based on experience

FORMS:
{基|もと} (base, foundation) + づく (to attach to)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to use ~ as a basis (more flexible)
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踏|ふ}まえる→踏まえる：07701_fumaeru⟧: to take ~ into consideration
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{則|のっと}る→則る：09030_nottoru⟧: to follow, conform to (more formal)
